content.title: About
content.content: Mixed nuts with peanuts, salted is a blend of roasted peanuts, cashews, almonds, hazelnuts and other nuts, lightly salted to enhance flavor. The nuts provide a crunchy texture, aromatic scent and a subtle salty note, making them an ideal snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanuts are technically legumes, not true nuts.
Mixed nut blends are popular in sports nutrition for their high protein and healthy fat content.
A small amount of salt can amplify the perception of sweetness in nuts.
Nuts in the blend are often roasted in oil with spices, giving them a distinctive aroma.
Portion‑controlled packets make it easy to manage serving sizes.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: The blend provides plant‑based protein essential for muscle repair and satiety.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids support heart health and help lower LDL cholesterol.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Peanuts and other nuts supply niacin, thiamine and folate, which aid energy metabolism.

items.title: Provides minerals
items.content: Magnesium, phosphorus and zinc from the nuts support muscle function, bone health and the immune system.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber in the nuts promotes intestinal motility and contributes to a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Tree nut and peanut allergy
items.content: People with allergies to nuts or peanuts may experience severe reactions when consuming the blend.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: The mix is calorie‑dense, so portion control is important, especially on weight‑management diets.

items.title: Salt content
items.content: Excessive salt intake can raise blood pressure; individuals with hypertension should limit consumption.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Whole nuts can pose a choking risk for young children.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the mixed nuts as a standalone snack, sprinkle them over salads, yogurt, muesli, or incorporate them into baked goods. For extra aroma, briefly toast the nuts in a dry pan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the mix in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For longer shelf life, keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent fat oxidation.
